title: More than six
intro: Some pieces of today's continents moved on their own: India, Iberia, Madagascar, Greenland and Mexico are now separate plates. Try the fit again.
questions: Where does freeing a piece close a gap or remove an overlap you could not fix before?
Where did India have to come from to reach Asia? What was in the way?
If today's continents are not the pieces that moved, how would you find the pieces that did?
